The Diagnosis compares the epigyne with H. cucullata Tang, Wang & Peng, 2012 (copulatory openings, atrium, epigynal hood) and the male palp with H. cordata, and gives no eye character. The eye sentence also gives interdistances (not recorded here). Dashes in the interdistance labels are en dashes (U+2013) as printed. Family Oxyopidae.
